hardware.variant: BCM2712 D0; 4 GiB RAM; nominal 64 GB eMMC

scenario: Power off, assert carrier BOOT, connect directly to a macOS host, release BOOT and load the fixed official RAM bundle.
expected: Host enumerates an eMMC mass-storage device and an ACM console; recovery services report no failed unit.
observed: Both USB functions appeared in approximately 10 seconds. ACM provided a recovery console. The eMMC was not mounted by the recovery environment. systemctl --failed reported zero failed units.
limits: Total observation duration was not recorded.
Carrier PCB revision, host OS version and rpiboot executable hash were not recorded.
This receipt covers enumeration and console access only, with no eMMC writes.
Normal EmberBSD boot, filesystem health and graphics were not tested.
A prior hub attempt failed, but UART wiring also changed; no isolated hub diagnosis was made.
